name: Balzac
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:mind+)Dubbed "Power Surging", Balzac is a strange-mask Teigu that, while fully worn, unleashes your full mental and physical potential past all limits while heavily straining mind and body. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by people who are compatible with it.
